authors: Anett Hoppe, David Morris, Ralph Ewerth
name: luh-iocw-image_description_templates
title: IOCW-Image_Description_Templates

resources.description:
The repository's content documents the conception of structured description templates and structured evaluation questionnaires for educational images, with the objective to improve accessibility for blind and visually impaired users. 

Included: 
**Description_Criteria_with_ Interview_Excerpts.pdf** -- Derived core criteria for efficient descriptions, and excerpts from the performed expert interviews that led to their formulation. 
**Templates for Image Descriptions.pdf** -- Structured image description templates 
**Questionnaire Questions.pdf** -- Structured evaluation questionnaire
**Image Description Overview.pdf** -- Entry document with links to (a) used example images, (b) description derived based on structured templates, (c) control description from formal description templates from an expert institution
**Template-based Image Descriptions** -- Folder containing sample images and corresponding descriptions, (a) using our template-based description approach, (b) control description from formal description templates from an expert institution
